SELECT dict_id, tenant_id, dict_name, dict_type, dict_status, remark, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, del_flag FROM sys_dict_type WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY dict_id ASC

SELECT dict_code, tenant_id, dict_sort, dict_label, dict_value, dict_type, css_class, list_class, is_default, parent_dict_code, linked_dict_type, linked_dict_value, dict_status, remark, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, del_flag FROM sys_dict_data WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY dict_code ASC

SELECT config_id, tenant_id, config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type, config_desc, sort, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, del_flag FROM sys_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY config_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_message_template ( tenant_id, template_code, template_name, type, title_template, content_template, default_channel, enabled, remark, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, create_dept, del_flag ) SELECT #{targetTenantId}, s.template_code, s.template_name, s.type, s.title_template, s.content_template, s.default_channel, s.enabled, s.remark, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, s.create_by, s.update_by, s.create_dept, 0 FROM sys_message_template s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{sourceTenantId} AND s.del_flag = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_message_template t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{targetTenantId} AND t.template_code = s.template_code AND t.del_flag = 0 )

INSERT INTO sys_message_biz_type ( tenant_id, biz_type, biz_name, jump_url, jump_target, icon, sort, enabled, remark, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, create_dept, del_flag ) SELECT #{targetTenantId}, s.biz_type, s.biz_name, s.jump_url, s.jump_target, s.icon, s.sort, s.enabled, s.remark, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, s.create_by, s.update_by, s.create_dept, 0 FROM sys_message_biz_type s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{sourceTenantId} AND s.del_flag = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_message_biz_type t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{targetTenantId} AND t.biz_type = s.biz_type AND t.del_flag = 0 )

INSERT INTO sys_flow_comment_phrase ( tenant_id, owner_type, user_id, scene, content, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, del_flag ) SELECT #{targetTenantId}, s.owner_type, COALESCE(s.user_id, 0), s.scene, s.content, s.sort_order, s.status, s.create_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, s.create_dept, s.update_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 FROM sys_flow_comment_phrase s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{sourceTenantId} AND s.del_flag = 0 AND s.owner_type = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_flow_comment_phrase t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{targetTenantId} AND t.owner_type = 0 AND t.scene = s.scene AND t.content = s.content AND t.del_flag = 0 )

INSERT INTO sys_flow_spel_template ( tenant_id, template_name, template_code, expression, description, category, example_params, status, sort, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted ) SELECT #{targetTenantId}, s.template_name, s.template_code, s.expression, s.description, s.category, s.example_params, s.status, s.sort, s.remark, s.create_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, s.update_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 FROM sys_flow_spel_template s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{sourceTenantId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_flow_spel_template t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{targetTenantId} AND t.template_code = s.template_code AND t.deleted = 0 )

INSERT INTO sys_data_scope_config ( tenant_id, resource_code, resource_name, mapper_method, table_alias, user_id_column, org_id_column, tenant_id_column, region_code_column, user_region_column, user_table_alias, flow_related_visible, flow_business_type, record_id_column, enabled, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, create_dept, del_flag ) SELECT #{targetTenantId}, s.resource_code, s.resource_name, s.mapper_method, s.table_alias, s.user_id_column, s.org_id_column, s.tenant_id_column, s.region_code_column, s.user_region_column, s.user_table_alias, s.flow_related_visible, s.flow_business_type, s.record_id_column, s.enabled, s.remark, s.create_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, s.update_by, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, s.create_dept, 0 FROM sys_data_scope_config s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{sourceTenantId} AND s.del_flag = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_data_scope_config t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{targetTenantId} AND t.resource_code = s.resource_code AND t.del_flag = 0 )
